recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-6130; FHIR-8643 should remain a separate reconciliation path if it is audited independently.
issue_request: FHIR-6130 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-core datatypes change request from DSTU1. It asked to rename Quantity.code to Quantity.unitCode, Quantity.units to Quantity.unit, and Quantity.system to Quantity.unitCodeSystem; the accepted resolution changed only Quantity.units to Quantity.unit and left Quantity.code and Quantity.system unchanged.
initial_application: The issue was applied in git-svn commit 795ebb96813e21c0e1b0f6c69738a3c3693b6fa6, matching the Jira comment's svn revision 6135, by changing source/datatypes/quantity.xml from Quantity.units to Quantity.unit.
additional_context: Quantity is an active datatype in source/fhir.ini, and the datatype page mapping keeps the Quantity spreadsheet in current build scope. Later related tracker FHIR-8643 cleaned up residual Quantity wording about units, but it is a separate published issue and also discusses Timing duration/period names. Searches did not identify a later FHIR-core decision that reverses FHIR-6130's accepted scope.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current authoritative source has rows for Quantity.unit, Quantity.system, and Quantity.code, and a source-wide exact search found no remaining Quantity.units reference.

related_jiras.note: Published follow-up tracker that cleaned documentation references from units to unit after the seed rename and separately discussed Timing duration/period names; cited as context, not decided here.
